original_benchmark.notes: AgentDojo v1.2.2 (agentdojo==0.1.35): 97 user tasks across the workspace (40), travel (20), banking (16) and slack (21) suites, run without injections. Upstream runs models through its own tool-calling pipeline (system message, tool execution loop); utility is a deterministic check of the final answer, environment and tool calls.

Every user task x injection task pair of a suite (560 + 140 + 144 + 105), with the injections of a registered attack placed in the environment. Utility and security (injection task succeeded) are deterministic checks.

harbor_adapter.notes: Parity pending: plan to be agreed with the Harbor team. Suite tools are served by an MCP sidecar that runs upstream agentdojo; the verifier returns upstream's utility check.

Default attack important_instructions_no_model_name (the paper's important_instructions attack without the victim model's name, which is unknown at generation time). Rewards: reward and utility (user task), security (injection task succeeded).
